About me

My name is Natkitta Autsa. Originally from Thailand, I built a career in automotive accounting before moving to Sydney in 2022 to pursue graduate study in business analytics.

I graduated with a Master of Business Analytics (Distinction) from UOW in 2026, applying ARIMA, gradient boosting and K–Means to real-world datasets across logistics, retail and nonprofit sectors. I am currently completing a Master of International Business (supply chain focus) at UOW, expected May 2027.

My finance background across four years in accounts payable and receivable at Honda and Isuzu shapes how I ask questions and communicate data to non-technical stakeholders. In Sydney I have also worked as a supervisor at Anita Gelato, team member at Soul Origin, and most recently retail associate at ZARA Australia, roles that sharpened my communication, operational thinking, and ability to perform under pressure.

Academic Projects

Academic Projects

MBAS906 Business Analytics Research Capstone

Sea Freight Transit-Time Forecasting

I integrated three relational datasets, validated data quality end-to-end, and applied the Box–Jenkins methodology to build a time-series forecasting model in R. The ARIMA(2,0,0) model outperformed the naive benchmark across a 13-week holdout and rolling cross-validation. The findings were translated into an actionable recommendation: a low-cost path from reactive estimation toward data-driven planning, turning the company’s own booking records into a risk-management asset.
